name: me.superpass/superpass
title: Superpass
description: Where the chip is in each country's passport, and how to read it with an iPhone.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Use this when the person asks which countries Superpass covers, or you need a country's code for get_chip_location. Give words to find a country by name. Not for one country's details: use get_chip_location. Answers the countries Superpass has researched, each with its code, its name and where the chip is in its passport in a few words; only the ones whose name has the words, when given.

words.description: words of a country's English name, or its two-letter code

tools.name: get_chip_location
tools.description: Use this when the person asks where the chip is in a passport or ID card, or why their iPhone does not read it. Give the country as a two-letter code or its English name. Not for whether a document is genuine: only the Superpass app reads and checks a chip. Answers where the chip is in that country's passport and how to hold an iPhone to read it, the older design if one is still valid, whether its ID card has a chip an iPhone reads and what opens it, the source the answer comes from and how sure it is, and the page on superpass.me.

country.description: a two-letter code (de) or the English name (Germany)

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Use this when the person asks to send feedback about Superpass, or when a Superpass tool could not do what they asked. Write a sentence or two about Superpass: what failed or what was missing, and the tool it was about. Never include the conversation, names, document numbers or anything else personal.
